description: Insurance supervisory statistics (EIOPA release vintages), insurers' SFCR figures quoted from the public QRTs, NAIC under its metadata-only access decision and published catastrophe-loss estimates kept as publisher revisions; insurer, market and event lookups as of a date under the Market publication cutoffs, with reviewable insurer identity and links to Natural Hazards events by citation.

semantic_constraints.as_of: only revisions published by the as-of cutoff (end of day, UTC) and acquired by the acquisition cutoff: the Market public_and_acquired policy
semantic_constraints.revisions: every EIOPA release is a vintage, a corrected SFCR and each new estimate publication are revisions; earlier revisions stay in history
semantic_constraints.publishers: estimates from different publishers are listed separately and never merged; figures shown side by side with definitions, currencies and periods
semantic_constraints.identity: published LEI and NAIC codes match exactly; name matches are reviewable candidates; group and solo reporting stay distinct and a group report reaches an undertaking only through a recorded ownership link
semantic_constraints.licences: every answer lists the IN01 licence decisions; excluded publishers are never acquired and metadata-only sources yield references without figures
semantic_constraints.exclusions: no solvency or rating assessment, no loss modelling, no computed ratio, reconciliation or aggregate across publishers
